status: frozen before second-encoder feature extraction and metrics
recognition_license: Apache-2.0 as stated by provider for the model directory
detector_license: MIT as stated by provider for the detector directory
backend: OpenCV 4.x DNN CPU; record exact installed version
multiple_faces: Select largest bounding-box area, then confidence, then lexicographic bounding-box coordinates
alignment: Official FaceRecognizerSF.alignCrop from selected YuNet five landmarks, 112x112 BGR
detection_failure: Keep the image and mark failure; deterministic center square crop resized112x112 BGR, no image/identity exclusion
features: FaceRecognizerSF.feature, L2-normalize output, require finite nonzero vectors
datasets: Same frozen original LFW and recovered CelebA image selections as R1; no outcome-based resampling
lfw_extended: Same 5557 extra identities and selected images; same gallery/distractor/calibration/test assignment
float_binary: Same gallery mean of two normalized image embeddings; cosine of normalized mean versus sign of same mean; same four probes and stable tie rule
thresholds: Recalibrate separately for each representation/model using calibration identities only; same empirical/conservative rules. Do not use provider verification threshold for identification.
uncertainty: Identity-level bootstrap after averaging repeated contexts, with the same conditioning limitations as R1
interpretation: Independent frontend including its alignment, not an isolated encoder-only ablation. Its128-bit roots are not confused with512-bit FaceNet roots or their MPC timings.
execution_policy: No CPU extraction concurrently with MPC timing; retain all adverse results and all detection-failure counts.
